apps.subtitle: Open-source Xray-core client for iOS, macOS, Android, Windows, and Linux. Smart routing, subscription management, and custom JSON configs. Available on the App Store, Google Play, and Microsoft Store
apps.localizedDescription:
Bring your own servers or subscription. OneXray does not provide VPN access or proxy servers.

Why OneXray:

• Across your devices. Use iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android, Windows or Linux, with light/dark themes and five interface languages.
• Your servers, organized. Import share links, Xray JSON and subscriptions. Group manual nodes and reorder them by dragging.
• Routing you control. Choose Smart or Custom Routing, or use complete Raw and provider configurations, including Remnawave subscriptions.

Get started:

• Install from the official store and complete setup and system permissions. Windows and Linux also need an outbound-interface selection.
• Open Servers and add your subscription, share links or Xray JSON. Complete provider configurations are recognized during subscription import.

versions.localizedDescription:
Apple:

• Use one Widget or Control Center switch to start or stop VPN in the background on supported iOS versions.

• iOS now requires version 16 or later.

Linux:

All platforms:

• Redesigned navigation and setup for phones, tablets and desktops.
• JSON editors now fill the available space.
• Connect without waiting for latency tests; logs clear before each new VPN session.
